starter_files.contents:
# Student Grade Manager

Run with `dotnet run`. Define a student record first, then implement validation, aggregate reporting, and persistence.

## Done when

- [ ] Add a student with an identifier and name
- [ ] Validate marks against the defined score range
- [ ] Compute average and assign a documented grade
- [ ] Search students and report an empty state
